title: Puttering Prismfish
statement: A thumb-sized, translucent fish with pleated rainbow fins putters through a dusk-blue tank, puffing little jets of water to arrange porcelain pebbles into spirals on the cream-colored sand. Beneath a single amber shaft of light, it leaves each pattern one pebble short, then hovers upside down in a basalt arch as though considering a better question.
